Delhi Police guidelines for journalists draw criticism

Delhi Police issued guidelines for journalists covering protests, which critics have called illegal and dangerous. The guidelines were introduced after police detained dozens of protesters, including journalists, who were demanding the resignation of the election chief over changes to voter rolls. Allegations of sexual harassment against journalists by police during this protest have also surfaced.
